nodes.description: OPA1 encodes a dynamin-related GTPase imported into mitochondria and located to the inner membrane and intermembrane space. In the recessive, syndromic Behr form, patients carry biallelic OPA1 variants — typically a dominant-optic-atrophy allele in trans with a second, hypomorphic/missense allele — reducing OPA1 function below the threshold tolerated in the dominant disease and producing a severe multisystem phenotype.
